replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Well, I use fraps to record just the gameplay, but if you want to record the whole screen, I would recommend Camtasia Studio. :D

Ps: Both programs can record Skype calls, so that won't be a problem! ^-^

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body: With the above programs like Fraps and such the issue is the free trials leave water marks. You want it as pro as you can. OBS is my recommendation. Very customizable, takes a small hit on FPS not like some others and the best of all it is free forever without water marks
